title: Deconvolve (CaImAn)
description: Spikes and denoised calcium of each trace by CaImAn, when it is installed: constrained foopsi in Python, and foopsi with the given sparsity in MATLAB (deconvolveCa), where CaImAn-MATLAB's constrained solver does not run on current releases.

signals.title: Traces
signals.description: Variable that holds the traces (frames x ROIs).

output.title: Spikes
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

denoisedOutput.title: Denoised calcium
denoisedOutput.description: Variable the denoised calcium is saved to. Leave empty to not save it.

lambda.title: Sparsity (MATLAB)
lambda.description: The ℓ1 penalty of foopsi in MATLAB, where CaImAn's constrained solver does not run; Python runs constrained foopsi, which chooses it
